label: Bible Study
prompt: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a _____ God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
verse: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said, I pray thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in my country? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish: for I knew that thou art a gracious God, and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repentest thee of the evil.
note: Jonah's complaint — he ran away precisely because he knew God would be merciful to Nineveh.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given _____ unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verse: Blessed be the LORD, that hath given rest unto his people Israel, according to all that he promised: there hath not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
note: Solomon at the Temple dedication: God gave rest, and not one word of His good promise has failed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a _____, and poured oil upon the top of it.
verse: And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
note: After the ladder dream, Jacob turned his stone pillow into a pillar and anointed it — the place he named Beth-el.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the _____ for our sins.
verse: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
note: John defines love by propitiation — the sacrifice that turns away wrath — so it's no minor word.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye _____ worship, him declare I unto you.
verse: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
note: On Mars' hill, Paul turns Athens' altar 'TO THE UNKNOWN GOD' into his sermon opener.
